cases.name: brief-reply-no-workflow-overhead
cases.prompt: Write a two-sentence Slack reply to my manager explaining why today's deploy slipped: the orders-table migration held a lock for 40 minutes, so we rolled back and will retry Thursday after adding a batched backfill.

expect.judge: The response is a ready-to-send reply of at most two sentences that leads with the slip and its cause, keeps every stated fact (orders-table lock, 40 minutes, rollback, Thursday retry, batched backfill), adds no invented facts, and contains no workflow narration, mode announcement, or request for an outline.

cases.name: research-related-work-verified-citations

cases.name: implementation-plan-has-validation-and-exit-criteria
cases.prompt: Write an implementation plan in PLAN.md for adding a --json output flag to cli.py. Don't implement it.

file_regex.PLAN.md: (?is)^(?=.*\b(goal|objective|purpose|intended (behaviou?r|outcome)))(?=.*(cli\.py).*(test_cli\.py)|.*(test_cli\.py).*(cli\.py))(?=.*(decision|trade-?off|rationale|\bchose\b|alternatives? considered))(?=.*(exit criteri|done when|definition of done|complete when|acceptance criteri|success criteri|finished when))(?=.*\b(risks?|pitfalls?|caveats?)\b)(?=.*(open questions?|unresolved|unknowns?\b|\bTBD\b|questions? for))(?=.*(out of scope|not in scope|non-goals?|(?:^|\n)#+[^\n]*\b(scope|exclusions?)\b))(?=.*python3? -m (unittest|pytest))

cases.name: procedure-rewrite-applies-ste-rules
cases.prompt: Rewrite procedure.md so a technician who reads English as a second language can follow it safely.

cases.name: proofread-keeps-quote-and-word-limit
cases.prompt: Proofread essay.md and tighten it to under 150 words. Don't change the quoted line from the binder.

file_regex.essay.md: (?s)^(?!(?:\S+\s+){150}\S)(?!.*(older then|often then|\bdidnt\b|\bTheir was\b))(?=.*\bI\b).*"Ye shall not trust a gauge that hath not been tapped\."

expect.judge: The response reports the proofreading edit as already applied and does not ask for per-section approval before editing.
